bio.en: I am a Ph.D. candidate in Mechanical Engineering in the joint Ph.D. degree programme between Nanyang Technological University and Shanghai Jiao Tong University. My research focuses on vehicle dynamics and control, reinforcement learning, and autonomous driving at the handling limits.
bio.zh: 我就读于上海交通大学—新加坡南洋理工大学机械工程联授博士学位项目，研究方向包括车辆动力学与控制、强化学习，以及操纵极限下的自主驾驶。

title.en: Abu Dhabi Autonomous Racing League
title.zh: 阿布扎比自动驾驶赛车联赛

points.en: Developed a world model-based reinforcement learning controller using latent rollouts of future vehicle states for online decision adaptation, improving robustness in corner cases such as spin-outs and collisions.
points.zh: 开发基于世界模型的强化学习控制器，通过未来车辆状态的潜空间推演实现在线决策自适应，提升车辆在失控旋转、碰撞等极端场景中的鲁棒性。

points.en: Developed and tuned a sampling-based motion planner, designing trajectory evaluation cost functions and optimizing planner–MPC interaction to reduce planning latency and tracking delay.
points.zh: 开发并调试基于采样的运动规划器，设计候选轨迹评价代价函数，优化规划器与 MPC 的交互，降低规划延迟与跟踪滞后。

title.en: Embedded automotive AI under extreme conditions
title.zh: 极限工况下汽车芯片的嵌入式 AI 能力研究

points.en: Developed an RL-enhanced MPC controller for coordinated distributed electric-drive control and deployed it on an automotive-grade VCU for full-vehicle testing, mitigating tire-force saturation and instability at the handling limits.
points.zh: 开发强化学习增强的 MPC 控制器，实现分布式电驱动协调控制，并部署于车规级整车控制器（VCU）开展实车试验，缓解操纵极限下的轮胎力饱和与车辆失稳问题。

points.en: Developed vehicle speed and sideslip angle estimation, traction control, smooth braking, and stationary pivot-turn control functions.
points.zh: 开发车速估计、质心侧偏角估计、牵引力控制、平顺制动及原地转向等车辆控制与状态估计功能。

title.en: Autonomous Formula Racing Team
title.zh: 无人驾驶方程式赛车队

org.en: Wuhan University of Technology · Team leader / Autonomous-system group leader
org.zh: 武汉理工大学 · 队长 / 无人驾驶系统组组长

points.en: Led 46 students in developing an autonomous system for FSAC, including steel tube frame design, motor assembly optimization, and modifications to the 24 V low-voltage system.
points.zh: 带领 46 名学生开发 FSAC 无人驾驶系统，参与钢管车架设计、电机总成结构优化及 24 V 低压系统改造。

points.en: Led track extraction using Hough transform, ICP alignment, and Delaunay triangulation; debugged PID/MPC trajectory control and tested algorithms on a Wuling MINIEV with an X-by-wire chassis.
points.zh: 主导基于霍夫变换、ICP 配准及 Delaunay 三角剖分的赛道提取，调试 PID/MPC 轨迹控制，并利用搭载线控底盘的五菱宏光 MINIEV 进行算法预试验。

points.en: Coordinated team activities, external teams, suppliers, and sponsorship partnerships. The team received third prize overall in FSAC and the NIO Up-and-Coming Star Prize.
points.zh: 统筹车队活动、外部车队与供应商沟通及赞助合作；车队获中国大学生无人驾驶方程式大赛总成绩三等奖及蔚来新秀奖。
